headline: Set Geno Smith as Joe Burrow's AutoSub before Sunday's 10:00 AM PT kickoff, but plan to start Burrow.
summary: Danny is 1-0 and his Week 2 lineup is already right: Chase Brown, Jaylen Warren and Aaron Jones anchor the flex spots, Nabers and Waddle start at WR, and Caleb Williams holds the superflex, so nothing needs to change there. The only open item is Joe Burrow's back-soreness tag; he was limited Wed-Thu but practiced fully Friday Sep 18 and is expected to play, so the job is just getting his AutoSub locked in before both Sunday 10 AM games kick off. No waiver claim is worth Danny's FAAB this week: the notable rival drops (Nicholas Singleton, Wan'Dale Robinson) don't clearly beat his bench.
